estimate.source: Assumptions for cmd/calibrate, chosen 2026-11-23 (decision 0009). Profile shape: a generic weekday AM peak, half the peak at 06:00 and still 60% at 10:30; only the time the peak starts is fitted. Search ranges: route-start traffic from light to above the 3-lane capacity (6000 veh/h); ramps from 10% to 80% full; exits from a fifth of to slightly above their lane share. Replace with counts when available. min_queue_match 0.8: an observed queue counts as reproduced when four fifths of its length is queued in the simulation; pins are rough, so not 1.

_note: PLACEHOLDER demand - must be filled before CTM results mean anything. Fill peak_vph from JKR/HPU Road Traffic Volume Malaysia (RTVM) census stations or LLM highway statistics, profiles from hourly counts, split ratios from ramp counts. Keys are OSM ids like config/corridors lane_drops: node:<id> for a point, way:<id> for a ramp way; the ids below were checked against the 2026-11-23 OSM extract (tags and travel direction); the numbers are still guesses. Entries and exits whose source starts with 'placeholder' are guesses.
